text:
nora: Quick follow-up from the postmortem and our remediation board review. We need an "alert choreography" plan: dedupe keys, soft-threshold smoothing, a canary choreography, and a short-term rollback hook. Capture owners + measurable signoff criteria here.

harry: I can take dedupe + grouping changes. Proposal: stop grouping by `instance` and move to `service:job:region:tier:error_code`. Add a 30s suppression and a 12m rolling dedupe window. Will include example group_key in PR and unit tests. ETA: Thu EOD.

lina: I'll own the smoothing/query migration. Current rule uses `avg_over_time(2m)` which flares. Plan: move to p95 over 5m with a 4m `for:` and add a median filter to ignore single-request spikes. Will run historical replay for last 14 days. ETA: Wed.

pavel: I'll do the canary choreography automation. Plan: route 15% traffic to new alert config for 48h with automatic monitoring of pages_per_min, unique_incidents, customer_error_rate, and mttack. Auto-revert if pages_per_min_canary > control by 25% AND customer_error_rate delta < 3% OR mttack doubles. ETA: Fri.

tom: I'll update the paging policy + PD mapping. Suggest we only escalate to human oncall if (A) >=2 regions or (B) same group fires 3x in 12m, and add a 20m per-responder backoff. Also add a `no_page=true` label to keep alerts visible but silent for known noisy flows. ETA: Fri noon.

nora: Good. A couple notes: (1) include `tier` so we don't mask prod-only regressions, (2) add region in group key to avoid hiding multi-region incidents, (3) keep the dashboards visible for silent alerts.

harry: noted. group_key = service + job + region + tier + error_code. I'll add examples.

lina: Draft PromQL I'm testing in replay:
```
# p95 over 5m by job/region/tier, require sustained 4m
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(uploader_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, job, region, tier)) > 1.1
for: 4m
```
This reduces one-off spikes and favors sustained regressions.

pavel: Canary metrics/listeners I'll capture: `pages_per_min`, `unique_incident_ids`, `customer_error_rate`, `mean_time_to_ack`. I'll publish a dashboard and a small alert that flags the canary if auto-revert conditions met.

tom: PD mapping note: when `no_page=true`, route to a review queue instead of paging. We'll keep severity on the alert so SRE can triage from dashboards. I'll include PD tests in staging.

audit-bot: Reminder: create remediation ticket and attach PRs to the incident. Also run an access audit for any PD integration changes.

nora: Owners & acceptance criteria (please confirm):
- Dedupe + tests: harry 3 ETA Thu EOD (PR + staging validation)
- Query smoothing + replay: lina 3 ETA Wed (14-day replay + comparison CSV)
- Canary orchestration + auto-revert: pavel 3 ETA Fri (automation playbook + dashboard)
- Paging policy + PD mapping: tom 3 ETA Fri noon (staging PD tests)

harry: confirmed. I'll post the group_key examples and unit tests.

lina: confirmed. I'll attach replay diffs and per-alert violin plots.

pavel: confirmed. Will add the auto-revert play and a canary runbook.

tom: confirmed. I'll post PD mapping test results.

audit-bot: Calendar event created: "Alert choreography sync" Wed 13:00 UTC 3 attendees: #eng-oncall. Reminder 20m prior.

nora: Acceptance for merge before canary: (1) dedupe PR passes unit tests + simulated run, (2) PromQL reduces pages on replay by >=35% for noisy set without increasing customer_error_rate >4%, (3) canary automation in place, (4) PD mapping tested in staging, (5) runbook updated with rollback steps and a post-deploy evaluation checklist.

harry: I'll add a small simulation harness so reviewers can run quick checks locally.

lina: If any alert degrades in replay, I'll annotate why and recommend mitigations (e.g., broaden job label or increase `for:`).

pavel: Canary orchestration will include a 2-hour sanity check before full 48h run. Manual hold if any critical customer metrics spike.

tom: After staging validation I'll request OPS sign-off on PD mapping.

nora: Great, keep this thread updated with PR links, replay CSVs, and dashboard screenshots. We'll run the canary only after all prechecks pass. Close the loop in the sync. :white_check_mark:
